# CyberGuard

CyberGuard is a gamified cybersecurity awareness platform.

## Purpose

CyberGuard helps users learn cybersecurity concepts through short interactive quizzes. Players complete missions, earn points, and compete on a real-time leaderboard.

## Main Topics

- Phishing
- Passwords and authentication
- Social engineering
- Public Wi-Fi security
- Data protection

## Gamification

Missions have three difficulty levels:

- EASY: 2 points
- MEDIUM: 5 points
- HARD: 10 points

Players cannot complete the same mission more than once.

## Main User Flow

Landing Page → Registration/Login → Play → Mission → Quiz → Result → Leaderboard.

## Architecture

CyberGuard is a modular monolithic application with a Next.js frontend and NestJS backend.

## Backend

NestJS, Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, JWT, WebSocket.

## Frontend

Next.js, React, TypeScript.

## Realtime

WebSocket is used for leaderboard and player score updates.
